exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Future perfect — will have + past participle

items.prompt: By December, we ___ some targets and beaten others.
By the end of the workshop, each department head ___ their assumptions down.
items.hintAfterError: Futuro perfeito: will have + particípio. 'Write' é irregular.

items.prompt: By March, the team ___ the forecast twice.
___ we ___ the sales target by the third quarter?
items.hintAfterError: Na pergunta, o auxiliar do futuro vai antes do sujeito; depois vem have + particípio irregular.

items.prompt: By the next review, the conservative assumptions ___ tested against real numbers.
